note: No commit handler yet. Maps to documents. A legacy import likely needs to place the actual file content behind the storage adapter (server/src/services/document-storage.service.ts) before this row can be committed with a real uri/hash - this template documents the metadata row shape, not a file-upload mechanism, which is a separate design concern.

fields.name: sourceUri
fields.description: Location of the legacy file to be re-stored through the storage adapter at commit time; not written directly to documents.uri.
fields.mapsTo: n/a (input to the storage adapter, not a column)

fields.name: createdAt
fields.description: Original generation timestamp from the legacy system, preserved for audit.
